sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Weapon crate (Rare) (Weapons (Rare)) is a Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Before Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Contains ammunition, weapon mods, or even weapons if you're lucky. Everything you need to make your enemies respect you. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

sections.heading: After Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Contains ammunition, weapon mods, or even weapons if you're lucky. Everything you need to make your enemies respect you. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
  - Must be un-locked at the Workbench level 1 before it can be opened
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
- Only the locked version can be stashed in Lucky Scav Junk box

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Possible reward from Ref's daily and weekly quests for Arena

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | Hand drill x1; Hand drill; +; Weapon crate (Rare) x1; Locked Weapon crate (Rare) | → | Workbench level 1; 1 minute | → | Weapon crate (Rare) x1; Unlocked Weapon crate (Rare) |

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: The crate can contain various weapons, grenades, weapon mods, ammunition and night vision devices.
